    10	/-!
    11	# Finite subsets of irreducible algebraic groups lie in affine opens
    12	
    13	This file formalizes the irreducible, algebraically closed core of
    14	[Stacks, Lemma 39.8.6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B7S). Translation
    15	turns one affine neighborhood of the identity into finitely many dense open
    16	subsets. Irreducibility gives a common closed point, and translating back gives
    17	one affine open containing the prescribed rational points.

    20	points: local finite type over a field makes the scheme Jacobson, so each point
    21	specializes to a closed point. It deliberately does not assert the remaining

    10	/-!
    11	# Orbit affineness for the finite-stage Picard glue
    12	
    13	A projective finite-stage glued representative has the finite-in-affine property, so every
    14	orbit of its canonical finite-Galois action lies in an affine open.  This file records that
    15	producer at the exact carrier `P.gluedOver` used by finite-stage descent.
    16	
    17	The projectivity argument is deliberately explicit.  The affine-chart glue package does not
    18	yet construct `P.gluedMap.IsProjective`; that geometric certificate remains the sole input of
    19	this bridge rather than being hidden in an auxiliary class.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory
    27	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	noncomputable section
    32	
    33	variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
    34	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    35	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
    40	  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    41	
    42	/-- Projectivity of the finite-stage glued morphism supplies orbit affineness for the
    43	canonical action attached to a representation of Picard zero by that exact glue. -/
    44	@[implicit_reducible]
    45	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective
    46	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    47	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
    48	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    49	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
    50	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    51	  Scheme.orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine _
    52	    (Scheme.finiteInAffine_of_isProjective hproj)
    53	
    54	end
    55	
    56	end AlgebraicGeometry
